text:
nina: deploy-bot flagged a p95 spike in ap-south during rollout to 40% — current p95 ~380ms (+150ms).
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 40%. Alert: p95 380ms. Suggested action: auto-revert to previous stable.
omar: traces show increased KV eviction churn on shared hosted pool; dedicated pools unaffected.
lee: business impact: a couple of power users reported slow responses but no errors. SLA risk if it holds.
tia: quick decision: instead of full revert, pin region to stable and route heavy customers to dedicated until we triage. avoids churn for unaffected regions.
nina: agree. manual pin to v4.0.2 for ap-south and create routing exception: `rwctl rollout set --region ap-south --version v4.0.2 --pin --reason "p95 spike"`
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Pinning v4.0.2 in ap-south. Creating routing override for high-traffic customer segments.
omar: I'll open an incident and capture kv histograms and eviction metrics from the affected nodes.
lee: CS: prepare customer note offering prioritized support and temporary routing to dedicated pools. Mention no data loss, just degraded latency.
tia: don't enable auto-unpin. wait for a root-cause or validated kernel/eviction patch.
nina: once incident issue is open, link here and I'll add to postmortem checklist: detection, decision rationale, routing workarounds, patch plan.
deploy-bot: Pin complete. Routing exception created for customers tagged heavy-traffic-ap.
lee: monitoring looks stable at 15m post-pin. keeping a 1h bridge open.
omaR: (typo) I mean omar: filing ticket and tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre with logs and reproducer commands.
tia: nice quick coordination, closing thread after postmortem link is added. :thumbsup:
